rv.q: Details: Forever Plaid is a very enjoyable night out packed into 90 minutes of non-stop entertainment by MadKap Productions at the Skokie Theatre, 7924 N. Lincoln Ave., Skokie, IL through June 29, 2025.
Forever Plaid is a romp through pitch-perfect harmonies and delightful comic timing.

Will they get to do their songs? The music is memorable and the homage to the Ed Sullivan Show ( you have to be of a certain age to truly appreciate this). Some of the songs of note: "16 Tons", "Love is a Many Splendored Thing" and of course, some Beatles music ( we loved that part).

cn.t: Critics praise this nostalgic 1950s musical revue for its heartwarming charm, lively performances, and pitch-perfect harmonies that deliver toe-tapping entertainment and zany tribute to classic boy bands.
